9 . Do not send sensitive information online via HTTP or FTP connections, because messages in these connections can be sniffed with very little effort. You should use encrypted connections such as HTTPS and SFTP whenever possible.

If you want a strong random password generator, use the one built into your password manager. If your password manager can't generate strong random passwords, get a better password manager.

Some password managers:

  • KeePassX
  • KeePass Password Safe
  • LastPass

If you absolutely must use a web based service to generate your passwords, please at least consider using one which is delivered by HTTPS.

Some web based random password generators which are delivered over HTTPS:
